In the grand arena of the decathlon, your journey defies the conventional wisdom of peak age. You have turned the multi-sport challenge into a test of technical endurance, treating each transition between events as a movement in a larger symphony. By bringing your focus on long-distance mental fortitude to the high-performance track, you have proven that longevity is not the end of a competitive story, but the beginning of its most sophisticated chapter.

This is not a pivot, but an evolution. At 48, your body is a refined instrument, capable of explosive bursts that are as calculated as they are powerful, ensuring that every ounce of your strength is utilized with total efficiency.
